value.rationale: Simultaneous conjugation of partial bijections is natural and distinct from product permutations. A complete simply connected Moore-space homotopy classification reveals order-five torsion created by quotienting an important canonical five-by-five chessboard complex, unlike its intrinsic three-primary torsion and invisible to rational Betti tables. The exact statement is neither a routine renaming nor a narrow unmotivated slice; the size five relates to the smallest full symmetric group supporting the observed five-primary phenomenon, without asserting an all-size result.
